summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms per the spec, without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gets Lambda (callable assertion "func must be callable", returns func(img) unchanged). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py gets Lambdad (MapTransform base validates keys, then builds one internal Lambda; call makes a shallow dict copy and applies it to each listed key), the Callable typing import, the Lambda import, and the LambdaD/LambdaDict alias line. docs/source/transforms.rst gets Lambda entry before SplitChannel and Lambdad entry after ConcatItemsd. New tests: tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py, covering identity and slicing callables, keys-view form, alias identity, non-callable AssertionError, and empty keys ValueError. Tests were not run; verification was by reading only.
